dedupe.result: All three additions are new to the completed ledger. They cover distinct evidence classes: experimental-profile-constrained inverse modeling on TJ-II, a numerically validated local-response composition for structured photocathodes, and analytic/PIC/fluid cross-validation of a radiatively cooling relativistic pair plasma.

evidence_boundary: Gallego et al. use real TJ-II temperature and density profiles, but the inferred conductivity is an effective parameter conditional on a reduced one-dimensional SOL equation and a heuristic LCFS location. Bazyl and Zagorodnov validate composition against a fully resolved 41 by 41 WarpX array, while the 521197-hole injector-scale result has no fully resolved truth and also inherits WarpX-to-IMPACT-T carrier offsets. Wierzchucka et al. obtain early-time agreement between analytic theory, radiative OSIRIS PIC and a two-phase fluid model; after about 2.2 cooling times the fiducial PIC is affected by numerical collisional isotropization, the long-time saturation is a fluid extrapolation, and the quantum parameter is far below the strong-field-QED regime. No author code or simulation was rerun locally.
